Is it the Japanese sense to want a mask?
Dec 2025 • Solo
The pho was delicious as usual, and the fresh spring rolls were also delicious with sauce.

The additional green peppers that came with the pho were too spicy and burned my tongue lol
Many customers are foreigners, so it's safe to say.
Banh mi 80,000 VD and cola 20,000 VD, and it is just too cheap, 100,000 VND, 600 yen.

The next day, I came to eat Banh Mi too, but I was concerned that the waiter coughed badly, so I got minus ➖1 stars.

I guess it's a Japanese feeling to want people to wear masks.
